integrity: The proof reconstructs the commuting relation from the nondegenerate alternating commutator form, proves the rank-one clique decomposition, and checks all ten pairings in a symbolic five-vector witness for every higher rank. A standalone checker replays the rank-one blow-up and rank-two witness over four prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to extraspecial p-groups.

The rank-one positive case is compatible with earlier CA-group and order-p^3 commuting-graph results; the claimed new content is the full extraspecial rank boundary and explicit uniform induced C5 in all higher ranks.
An equivalent higher-rank obstruction could exist in symplectic finite-geometry terminology not captured by commuting-graph searches.
title: Extraspecial commuting graphs are perfect exactly in rank one
